'''Amille Razna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who served in the [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Amille Razna was in command of a group of [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] sent to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to put a halt to the violent scavenging that was occurring. During the investigation, Razna attempted to arrest a particular violent scavenger known as [[Locust|The Locust]]. However, she and her team were captured by the gang until they were rescued later by an individual in which the Locust was captured.<ref name="SWTORLocust" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amille Razna appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the "Fall of the Locust" heroic mission.
